decisions.rationale: Didaktische Konkretisierung des angegebenen tatsächlichen Inhalts; keine Behauptung eines wörtlichen oder vollständig eigenständigen amtlichen Kompetenzpunkts. Allele-frequency counting is not a literal Q1.1.6 original duty. It is a quantitative operationalization of population-genetic systems; proposed real source span is Q2.1 plus cross-topic genetic background. PhaseQ1 remains compatibility metadata, not asserted source location. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.

Nicht amtlich benannte und nicht verpflichtende Zusatzmodellvertiefung; die allgemeine Sach-/Modellkompetenz macht dieses konkrete Modell nicht zur amtlichen Pflicht. Hardy-Weinberg is not a verbatim Q1.1.7 original item and is not made a universal named HE compulsory theorem by this author. The current goal explicitly requests calculation/interpretation; it may be supported as a transparent didactic model within population genetics subject to independent source/scope review. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.

Didaktische Konkretisierung des angegebenen tatsächlichen Inhalts; keine Behauptung eines wörtlichen oder vollständig eigenständigen amtlichen Kompetenzpunkts. Drift is explicit original content; bottleneck/founder and numeric sampling are reasoned concrete examples for the current calculation goal, not verbatim Q1.1.8 original text. Independent-binomial sampling is a stated toy-model assumption. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.

Didaktische Konkretisierung des angegebenen tatsächlichen Inhalts; keine Behauptung eines wörtlichen oder vollständig eigenständigen amtlichen Kompetenzpunkts. Fossils and anatomical homology are not a verbatim Q2.1 three-item requirement. Their use relates the whole Q2 overview and E.1 organelle evolution to evidence evaluation; molecular homology is retained as an actual original duty. No claim that each example is a distinct obligatory independent experiment. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.

Didaktische Konkretisierung des angegebenen tatsächlichen Inhalts; keine Behauptung eines wörtlichen oder vollständig eigenständigen amtlichen Kompetenzpunkts. Allopatric/sympatric are scientifically appropriate didactic differentiations of the original broad speciation/isolation duty; they are not printed as a separate original bullet. Spatial separation alone does not complete speciation. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.

Didaktische Konkretisierung des angegebenen tatsächlichen Inhalts; keine Behauptung eines wörtlichen oder vollständig eigenständigen amtlichen Kompetenzpunkts. The explicit LK duty is retained whole. Hypothetical branching trees and spread are not individual family pedigrees; language repair is proposed separately. No single linear ladder or ranking of present-day humans. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.

Didaktische Konkretisierung des angegebenen tatsächlichen Inhalts; keine Behauptung eines wörtlichen oder vollständig eigenständigen amtlichen Kompetenzpunkts. The explicit LK duty is retained whole. Tools and language are related but material culture does not independently establish spoken language or its exact origin. No acquired instructions inherited as genes. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.

Didaktische Konkretisierung des angegebenen tatsächlichen Inhalts; keine Behauptung eines wörtlichen oder vollständig eigenständigen amtlichen Kompetenzpunkts. Canonical description covers proximate exogenous/endogenous causes; the original whole source also names reproductive behavior. The cases include reproductive context without making this canonical atom the sole complete source-row witness or requiring animal manipulation. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.

Didaktische Konkretisierung des angegebenen tatsächlichen Inhalts; keine Behauptung eines wörtlichen oder vollständig eigenständigen amtlichen Kompetenzpunkts. Hybridization is not a verbatim separate curriculum item here. Examples compare speciation mechanisms under the original broad duty and LK scientific depth; hybridization alone does not establish a stable species. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.

Nicht amtlich benannte und nicht verpflichtende Zusatzmodellvertiefung; die allgemeine Sach-/Modellkompetenz macht dieses konkrete Modell nicht zur amtlichen Pflicht. Molecular clocks are not a verbatim named original item. Their explicit calibrated model is a didactic specialization of molecular evidence/phylogenetic hypotheses; no universal compulsory rate, fossil, or exact date is invented. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.

Didaktische Konkretisierung des angegebenen tatsächlichen Inhalts; keine Behauptung eines wörtlichen oder vollständig eigenständigen amtlichen Kompetenzpunkts. Hominid/hominin hypotheses and cultural feedback are discussed using evidence. No original separate numbered Q2.2 specialization is claimed; the actual scope is Q2.1 LK. This is a deeper current canonical competency, not literal duplication of an original bullet. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.

Optionales Themenfeld Q2.2 LK; keine allgemeine verpflichtende HE-Kompetenz. Q2.2 is not among obligatory fields1and3. It can support the current canonical atom as optional LK content, not as a universal HE mandatory core. Source duty status must be corrected explicitly; no current goal or denominator is hidden. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.

Didaktische Konkretisierung des angegebenen tatsächlichen Inhalts; keine Behauptung eines wörtlichen oder vollständig eigenständigen amtlichen Kompetenzpunkts. Stabilizing/directional/disruptive selection are valid model distinctions of the broad selection duty, not a printed separate LK-only bullet. The present canonical LK goal remains unchanged; examples do not enlarge compulsory source scope. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.

Nicht amtlich benannte und nicht verpflichtende Zusatzmodellvertiefung; die allgemeine Sach-/Modellkompetenz macht dieses konkrete Modell nicht zur amtlichen Pflicht. Fitness landscapes/local optima are not a verbatim Q2.2 item; Q2.2 concerns ethical tension. Proposed source identity must change to transparent Q2.1 modeling specialization. No claim of universal obligatory landscape mathematics or automatic global optimization. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.

Didaktische Konkretisierung des angegebenen tatsächlichen Inhalts; keine Behauptung eines wörtlichen oder vollständig eigenständigen amtlichen Kompetenzpunkts. Coevolution is explicitly named at basic level. Current LK emphasis is a canonical depth choice, not proof the original topic is LK-only. Predator-prey, host-parasite and pollination are alternatives, not a three-category task quota. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.

Didaktische Konkretisierung des angegebenen tatsächlichen Inhalts; keine Behauptung eines wörtlichen oder vollständig eigenständigen amtlichen Kompetenzpunkts. Sexual selection is not printed as an exact Q3 duty. The proposed source identity is Q2.1 behavior/fitness with appropriate LK depth. No human prescription or sex-based worth claim follows. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.

Didaktische Konkretisierung des angegebenen tatsächlichen Inhalts; keine Behauptung eines wörtlichen oder vollständig eigenständigen amtlichen Kompetenzpunkts. Cladistics and molecular methods operationalize actual original content. The normalized Q3.3 row is not the original location. Homology, outgroups, orthology and conflicting data are explicit; true typo/English correction requires targeted independent review and A/M rebinding. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.

Didaktische Konkretisierung des angegebenen tatsächlichen Inhalts; keine Behauptung eines wörtlichen oder vollständig eigenständigen amtlichen Kompetenzpunkts. Sequence-based phylogeny is a didactic implementation of original molecular evidence, not a separate literal Q3.3 original bullet. No gene-tree/species-tree equivalence or mandatory bioinformatics tool is invented. Author candidate only; final targeted independent source A/B reviews pending.
